findings.name: SQL Injection
findings.risk_summary: User input concatenated into SQL query enables data exfiltration.
findings.description: The username parameter is concatenated into the query string without sanitization.
findings.evidence: const query = `SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '${username}'`;
findings.mitigation: Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection.
findings.fixed_code: const query = `SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?`; db.query(query, [username], (err, results) => { // Fixed: parameterized query })

findings.name: Command Injection
findings.risk_summary: User input concatenated into command enables code execution.
findings.description: The filename parameter is concatenated into the command string without sanitization.
findings.impact: Arbitrary file read, potential code execution.
findings.mitigation: Use a child process exec function with separate arguments to prevent command injection.
